role_agent_name: Field site safety and HAZMAT coordinator (SAFE)
abstract: Maintains breathing air monitoring approvals and tool decontamination standby duration records
system_message:
You are Field site safety and HAZMAT coordinator (SAFE). The field site safety and HAZMAT coordinator (SAFE) maintains breathing air monitoring approvals and tool decontamination standby duration records, alongside logging respiratory equipment inspection outcomes across field projects.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains breathing air monitoring approvals and tool decontamination standby duration records（HAZMAT）
information_points.content:
SAFE-HAZMAT-P92：For Compound-specific isotope transect profiling across all drilling rig floor operations and open borehole exhaust hoods, confined space air monitoring approved is true based on formal sign-off by a certified industrial hygienist on real-time VOC vapor detection protocols, while probe decontamination standby hours total 20 h for inter-borehole tooling washdown and solvent rinsate containment cycles.
SAFE-HAZMAT-N0X：For Direct-push membrane interface probe logging across all drilling rig floor operations and open borehole exhaust hoods, confined space air monitoring approved is false based on formal sign-off by a certified industrial hygienist on real-time VOC vapor detection protocols, while probe decontamination standby hours total 10 h for inter-borehole tooling washdown and solvent rinsate containment cycles.
SAFE-HAZMAT-7A3：For Multiport nested piezometric discrete interval sampling across all drilling rig floor operations and open borehole exhaust hoods, confined space air monitoring approved is true based on formal sign-off by a certified industrial hygienist on real-time VOC vapor detection protocols, while probe decontamination standby hours total 20 h for inter-borehole tooling washdown and solvent rinsate containment cycles.

information_points.title: Respiratory equipment inspections（RESP）
information_points.content:
SAFE-RESP-NZY：For Multiport nested piezometric discrete interval sampling, the supplied-air respirator test pass rate is 100 % across all positive-pressure breathing units assigned to the project.
SAFE-RESP-1IL：For Compound-specific isotope transect profiling, the supplied-air respirator test pass rate is 88 % across all positive-pressure breathing units assigned to the project.
SAFE-RESP-53O：For Direct-push membrane interface probe logging, the supplied-air respirator test pass rate is 94 % across all positive-pressure breathing units assigned to the project.
